name: 08550 · Princeton Jct, NJ
findings: ZIP 08550 (Princeton Jct) has 114 nonprofit organizations. 54 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 46 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (15% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 08550 (Princeton Jct) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 08550 (Princeton Jct) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.2 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 31 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.
